name: Music Box
description: A tone matrix with drums and five instruments, three song slots, and a Voice Lab that turns the child's own voice into an instrument.

about.concept: Pattern and rhythm. A tone matrix turns a grid of choices into a repeating melody, so the child hears how changing one cell changes the whole, and learns beats, bars and layers by building them.
about.progression: Free play is an open tone matrix with drums, five instruments, three saved songs and a Voice Lab for the child's own voice. The Challenges ladder uses the same grid, from steady beat, high and low, and loud and soft at pre-K, through rhythms, echoes, scales, intervals, major and minor, chords and time signatures, up to key signatures, chord progressions, reading a staff and composing to a rule in 8th grade.
